findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

Observed no CFPM present during the inspection. Employee is a food handler and is the person who prepared the hot dogs and torpedo’s this morning. Discussed with PIC that the facility must have one certified food protection manager present during handling of food such as morning hot dog and torpedo preparations. Ensure more than one CFPM is available for the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

Observed no soap at the back room hand sink. Discussed with PIC that soap should be replaced as it runs out. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

Observed the back room hand sink to be coming away from the wall. Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure hand sink is securely re-attached to the wall and properly caulked. Repair before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. 

(REPEAT) Observed large accumulation of frost and ice pooling at base of walk-in freezer. Discussed repairs with PIC. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 6/24/2020.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

(REPEAT) Observed the mop not hanging in a manner that allows to drip or air dry. Moved mop in a position to allow appropriate drying. Discussed proper mop storage with PIC. This is a repeat violation: 11/18/2019 and 6/24/2020.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text:
4-101.19  (C) Nonfood-contact surfaces of walk-in freezer is no longer easily cleanable. Reference 4-101.19.

Observed large accumulation of frost and ice on walk-in freezer floor. Discussed repairs with PIC.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on walk-in cooler fans. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

Observered dust accumulation on walk-in cooler fans. Discussed routine cleaning of non-food contact surfaces with PIC.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11  (C) Three compartment sink found in a state of disrepair, or not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

Observed three compartment sink to be missing caulk between sink and wall. Discussed re-caulking with PIC. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/18/2019. Observed piece of wall missing near walk-in cooler before you enter to the left of the door. Exposed insulation is present. Discussed repairs with PIC. 

(REPEAT) 6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.

Observed mop to be drying within the mop bucket and not hung in a manner that allows to air dry and/or drip dry. Discussed proper mop storage with PIC. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/18/2019.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11  (C) Three compartment sink area found not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

Observed 3 compartment sink missing caulk between sink and wall. Observed multiple small holes in wall near 3 compartment sink and back room handsink. Must be caulked in order to avoid pests and/or mold build-up. Discussed with PIC. All surfaces must be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: A cardboard box from monster drinks is being used under the cabinet to hold single use boats. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Trade cardboard out of and item that is cleanable.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: The quat in a bottle which is used to clean thermometer after taking temperatures contains 100ppm of quat upon arrival. 750-800b To prevent cross-contamination, kitchenware and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any interruption of operations during which time contamination may have occurred. Sanitizing by swab sanitize method my take place with chemical sanitizer that meets the requirements of this code. 200ppm quat. Bottle was refilled with sanitizer from the 3 part dispenser and is now 200ppm of quat. Suggest keeping bottle only half full so that the sanitizer is used and refreshed on a regular bases and does not have the opportunity to break down to 100ppm.

findings.comment: The trim on the wall nezt to the mop sink has an edge trip piece which is comming off and allowes raw wood to be exposed to moisture. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. Trim was placed bacl onto the corner and the management is going to seal it wil glue or silicone caulk.  Finish repair so that it is durable under conditions of normal use.
